pages.title: Shield System: Parameter Formulas
pages.text: Let k be the total number of Shield Generators. Among all generators linked to the Control Seat, let max be the greatest distance between any two generators and min the smallest:$(br2)Energy used to intercept one projectile: (100*k*max^2)/min. In other words, every generator loses (100*max^2)/min FE per interception.$(br2)Total regeneration rate: max*k*500/tick. While linked batteries have sufficient energy, each non-full generator draws max*500 FE per tick to restore its own energy.

pages.title: Shield System: Parameter Formulas
pages.text: Let k be the total number of Shield Generators. Among all generators linked to the Control Seat, let max be the greatest distance between any two generators and min the smallest:$(br2)Shield overload cooldown: max*50/min ticks. When shield energy reaches zero, regeneration cannot begin for max*50/min ticks.

pages.title: Shield System: Parameter Formulas
pages.text: Clearly, destroying one Shield Generator during combat does not collapse the entire system, but it can significantly change the shield's performance.$(br2)A robust shield layout must balance mounting positions on the subspace, desired performance, and resistance to component loss.
